# Public document golden fixtures

These are exact, unmodified public YES BANK filings downloaded from Business Standard's public
filing mirror. Their actual acquisition URLs, timestamps, hashes and sizes are in manifest.json.
No premium/authenticated source, cookies, OCR, or document rewriting was used. Original BSE
viewer/direct presentation URLs returned HTTP 406; issuer/NSE copies timed out in this environment.
The mirror URLs are independently published links, not silently substituted URLs in a retrieval.

The investor presentation bundle contains the exchange letter, press release and presentation;
its physical PDF page 6 starts the deck. The transcript includes one exchange-cover page, so
physical page 2 is printed "Page 1 of 15". All evidence page numbers are physical, one-indexed.

expected_yesbank.json was hand-specified from original pages visually rendered with Poppler,
including presentation pages 1, 3, 6, 62 and transcript pages 2, 3, 16. Expected financial tokens,
headings and phrases were read from those pages, not generated by the application parser.
Physical final pages confirm the page inventory. Hash expectations come from the original file
bytes, independently of normalization. Both source documents contain extractable text on all pages.
A COMPLETE text extraction does not promise semantic section completeness or reconstructed tables.

Never regenerate the golden JSON from parser output. If a golden expectation appears wrong,
follow AGENTS.md: show source evidence and obtain explicit approval before changing it.
Synthetic error/scan/empty PDFs are generated locally by tests using pypdf and are not represented
as public fixtures. Automated tests never download or refresh these files.
